name: better-zsh
description: Improved zsh shellscript code editing experience

betterZsh.zshPath.markdownDescription: Path to the zsh binary. Leave empty to use `zsh` from PATH. Set to `off` to never invoke any zsh binary.

languageModelTools.name: zsh_docs
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Render markdown for a zsh token or canonical id from the bundled static zsh-5.9 reference.

Omitting `--category` can return multiple matches for overlapping syntax. The category list above is resolver order.

Resolution turns input forms into canonical ids:
  AUTO_CD     -> option/autocd
  NO_AUTO_CD  -> option/autocd (feedback: input-negated)
  %1          -> job_spec/%number

Output:
  matches[]          matched records
  matchesReturned    returned match count
  matchesTotal       total match count

Each match:
  category           doc category
  id                 canonical id
  display            zsh-facing name
  mdBody             rendered markdown
  subKind            optional category facet
  feedback           optional lossy-resolution signal

No matches: empty `matches[]`, exit code 0. Returned `id` values are valid `--key` inputs.

No shell execution, no environment access.

key.description:
Zsh token or canonical id

Examples: AUTO_CD, [[, %1, autocd

category.description:
Restrict to one doc category.

If omitted, all categories are tried, in the order given below.

Valid values:

  value
  -----
  complex_command       complex command
  reserved_word         reserved word
  precmd                precommand modifier
  builtin               builtin
  cond_op               conditional operator
  special_function      special function
  shell_param           shell parameter
  process_subst         process substitution
  param_expn            parameter-expansion form
  param_flag            parameter-expansion flag
  subscript_flag        subscript flag
  glob_flag             glob flag
  glob_qualifier        glob qualifier
  glob_op               glob operator
  history               history designator
  prompt_escape         prompt escape
  job_spec              job spec
  zle_widget            ZLE widget
  keymap                ZLE keymap
  arith_op              arithmetic operator
  option                option
  redir                 redirection

languageModelTools.name: zsh_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Find candidate records in the bundled static zsh-5.9 reference by id/display heading.

Resolution turns input forms into canonical ids:
  AUTO_CD     -> option/autocd
  NO_AUTO_CD  -> option/autocd (feedback: input-negated)
  %1          -> job_spec/%number

Ranking:
  1. exact id/display
  2. resolved input
  3. prefix
  4. fuzzy score

`score` is 1 for exact/resolution/prefix matches. Fuzzy matches use a score in (0,1).

No markdown body. Use `zsh_docs` for full docs.

To enumerate without a query, use `zsh_list`.

No shell execution, no environment access.

query.description: Search string matched against ids and display headings. Empty or whitespace returns no matches; use `zsh_list` to enumerate.

limit.description:
Limit the number of matches to return. Use 0 to return only metadata.

Default: 20

languageModelTools.name: zsh_list
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Return id/display records from the bundled static zsh reference.

Identifiers only. Use `zsh_docs` for rendered markdown.

Order:
  category omitted: default category order
  category set: that category's corpus order

Each match in `matches[]`:
{
  "category": "...",
  "id": "...",
  "display": "...",
  "subKind": "..."
}

`subKind` is only present for categories with a meaningful sub-facet.

No shell execution, no environment access.

category.description:
List only one doc category.

scripts.format: biome check --error-on-warnings --write src build.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.vscode-test.json vitest.config.ts package.json .vscodeignore .vscode-test.mjs scripts
scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings src build.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.vscode-test.json vitest.config.ts package.json .vscodeignore .vscode-test.mjs scripts
scripts.testINTERACTIVE:electron-bundled: pnpm build && scripts/package-vsix ./better-zsh.vsix && tsc -p tsconfig.vscode-test.json && scripts/testINTERACTIVE-bundled
scripts.vsix: pnpm build && export BZ_SKIP_UPSTREAM=1 && pnpm check && pnpm test && scripts/package-vsix ./better-zsh.vsix
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm build && export BZ_SKIP_UPSTREAM=1 && pnpm check && pnpm test && scripts/package-vsix /tmp/better-zsh-smoke.vsix && rm /tmp/better-zsh-smoke.vsix && echo 'smoke: OK'
